regime.summary: Policy rate held at 10.5% but the 6M bill cutoff sits 0.65pp above it, so the curve prices hikes. CPI is rising and Brent is up 64% in three months. The KSE100 is up 11.6% in one month after a 9.1% three-month fall, so the rebound is already half done. Past tightening-plus-external-stress regimes favoured bills. No entry is supported by a measured edge, so stay in cash and watch.

evidence.quote: Policy rate 10.5%; last MPC decision 2026-03-09: hold (+0bp)
6M T-bill minus policy rate +0.65pp (market pricing hikes); CPI rising over 3 months (+1.7pp)
Lesson: hold bills, and set a trigger to return.

watch.subject: Next SBP MPC decision (hold vs hike)
watch.trigger: A hike confirms the curve and keeps stance defensive; a hold with the 6M cutoff falling back toward 10.5% is the signal to re-enter in stages.

evidence.quote: 6M T-bill minus policy rate +0.65pp (market pricing hikes)

watch.subject: KSE100 index after the 3-month drawdown
watch.trigger: Buy only on a known trigger (a failed retest of the low or an MPC hold with calm CPI); index shock buys show 50% hit at 60 sessions.
